reasoning_traces.think:
The 19-match cricket dataset exhibits extreme overfitting due to its finite-sample nature, rendering posterior uncertainty intractable. Conformal prediction fails because calibration requires an independent holdout set, which the authors lack. The 61 features represent a high-dimensional projection onto a low-rank manifold, causing singular-value decay that annihilates signal-to-noise ratios. Transfer learning to NFL contexts breaks down because the underlying Markov decision processes differ fundamentally: cricket is turn-based with explicit resource constraints, while NFL plays in continuous time with imperfect-information state spaces. The EDA merely describes summary statistics; it does not capture the dynamic, multi-agent strategic equilibria that define NFL coaching decisions. Cross-layer veto conditions include the absence of ball-tracking data (cricket vs. NFL Next Gen Stats) and incompatible temporal granularities (match-level vs. play-level).
